name: Addigy
summary: Addigy manages Apple devices, with MDM plans starting at $8.25 per Mac a month and a 14-day free trial that needs no payment details. Policies are hierarchical, so child policies inherit settings from parents. iOS devices are an add-on at a rate the pricing page does not state.

facts.text: Addigy's help article says the console can push a Remote Lock or Remote Wipe command to an MDM-enrolled device, and the device does not need a specific policy assigned.
Once an Automated Device Enrollment token is uploaded, devices enroll automatically during first setup or after a wipe, and Apple tokens need yearly renewal.
Policies are hierarchical, so assets and settings added to a parent policy are inherited by its child policies.
The pricing page says no multi-year contracts are required and that committing to a multi-year plan can lower the rate.
Addigy's compliance page says it performs regular SOC 2 Type 2 audits and holds a SOC 3 report, with report access requiring an NDA.

plans.name: Apple MDM
plans.notes: Listed as starting at $8.25. Managed service providers get lower rates

hiddenCosts: iPhone, iPad and Apple TV management is an add-on, and the pricing page does not state its rate.
Migration services are scoped and quoted separately.
The pricing page says Addigy Intelligence was free for all customers through October 31, 2026 and then becomes a paid tier, with no price listed.
